correctness.rationale: The generator-to-coefficient identity follows by block triangularity and the nilpotent transient shift; exact rational recurrence reproduces P,U,V. All nine remaining rational numerators have nonnegative coefficients. Exact Sturm sign variations certify exactly two positive P roots, no positive U root and exactly two positive V roots, and rational sign brackets order all four thresholds. The no-failure result for n<=6 follows because c5,T6 first appear for n=7. Exact independent seven-by-seven matrix inverses reproduce the coefficients and absorbing remainders. Finite tests are implementation checks only.

value.rationale: Accurate Markov simulation demands nonnegative probabilities, and even an A-stability or mass-conservation argument would not establish this. The exact smallest failure in the natural homogeneous birth-cascade ladder and three disconnected admissible step intervals identify two distinct sign obstructions and a narrow recovery that monotone timestep criteria miss. This is a meaningful fixed-map structural benchmark, not a generic Padé formula or arbitrary parameter slice. Its scope is explicitly restricted to homogeneous directed absorbing chains.
